evidence: We currently use machine learning and AI to improve our products and processes in certain circumstances. Our machine learning models and AI contribute to multiple capabilities across our business.

For example, we use machine learning and AI to increase the efficiency of our in-app chat support, customer support workflows, fraud detection systems, and even to improve the customer experience in our newsfeed
We currently expect our adoption of AI to occur in three phases: by augmenting internal operations, by enhancing customer-facing products, and by developing sophisticated autonomous financial agents.
we have begun to incorporate applications of generative AI into our product offerings, such as Robinhood Cortex
we expect to introduce significantly more in the coming year, including our first AI-native advisory products
ai_positioning.summary: Robinhood a lancé Robinhood Cortex en 2024-2025, sa plateforme d'IA générative et d'analyse de marché destinée aux investisseurs particuliers. Cortex propose des insights personnalisés, du screening d'actions et de l'analyse de portefeuille assistée par IA. Robinhood positionne l'IA comme un différenciateur produit majeur pour démocratiser l'analyse financière.

company_description: Robinhood Markets, Inc. operates financial services platform in the United States. The company's platform allows users to invest in stocks, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), and American depository receipts. It offers fractional trading, recurring investments, access to investing on margin, fully-paid securities lending, cash sweep, instant withdrawals, retirement program, around-the-clock trading, joint investing accounts, event contracts, future contract services, and short selling. The company also provides various learning and education solutions comprise Snacks, an accessible digest of business news stories for a new generation of investors; Learn, which is an online collection of guides, feature tutorials, and financial dictionary; Newsfeeds that offer access to free, premium news from sites from various sites, such as Barron's, Reuters, and Dow Jones. In addition, the company offers In-App Education, a resource that covers investing fundamentals, including why people invest, a stock market overview, and tips on how to define investing goals, as well as allows customers to understand the basics of investing before their first trade; and Crypto Learn and Earn, an educational module available to various crypto customers through Robinhood Learn to teach customers the basics related to cryptocurrency. Further, it provides Robinhood credit cards, cash card and spending accounts, and wallets. Robinhood Markets, Inc. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.

risks.title: Cadre réglementaire des cryptomonnaies et titres financiers
risks.summary: Régulation crypto et titres évolutive: risque central sur revenus PFOF et actifs numériques.
risks.score_rationale: « our business could be materially and adversely affected by a cybersecurity breach » (Section Summary of Risk Factors, tête d'Item 1A, langage "materially and adversely"). Formulation matériellement adverse en tête d'Item 1A + coeur du modèle Robinhood dépendant du régime SEC/CFTC crypto.

risks.title: Cybersécurité et attaques sur la plateforme
risks.summary: Brèche cyber, ransomware ou attaque sur portefeuilles crypto: risque matériel.
risks.score_rationale: « our business could be materially and adversely affected by a cybersecurity breach » (Résumé Item 1A, langage renforcé "materially and adversely affected"). Broker retail visible et actifs numériques sur bilan: cible cyber élevée, formulation renforcée.

risks.title: Concurrence et pression sur les prix
risks.summary: Concurrence intense sur commissions et PFOF, avec entrants zéro-fee et acteurs crypto.
risks.score_rationale: « we operate in highly competitive markets, and many of our competitors » (Résumé Item 1A, langage descriptif "highly competitive markets"). Concurrence Schwab/Coinbase/Fidelity citée mais formulation conditionnelle standard, sans exposition chiffrée.

risks.title: Concentration de revenus PFOF et intérêts
risks.summary: Interdiction ou réforme du PFOF, ou baisse des taux, comprimerait les revenus principaux.
risks.score_rationale: « changes in these laws and regulations, or our failure to comply » (Résumé Item 1A, PFOF cité comme risque principal). PFOF et net interest sont l'essentiel du CA; changement réglementaire matériel documenté (SEC).

risks.title: Litiges, enquêtes et actions réglementaires
risks.summary: Enquêtes et procédures récurrentes des régulateurs américains et étrangers.
risks.score_rationale: « we have been subject to regulatory investigations, actions » (Résumé Item 1A, mention explicite d'enquêtes). Historique d'actions FINRA/SEC documenté; formulation factuelle, pas d'exposition chiffrée annoncée matérielle.

risks.title: Talents clés et rétention des ingénieurs
risks.summary: Difficulté à recruter et retenir ingénieurs et talents produit.
risks.score_rationale: « might continue to adversely affect our reputation among job seekers » (Deuxième tiers d'Item 1A, langage conditionnel "might"). Formulation prudentielle, boilerplate secteur tech; pas de dépendance chiffrée à des clés individuelles.
